name: AI sentience — feedforward Phi~0 vs recurrent
substrate: ECA n=4, I=0.21232 (1-I TPM scale); feedforward proxy SHIFT(r170)+IDENTITY(r204), recurrent rule110 ring
falsifier: feedforward big-Phi >= recurrent big-Phi (feedforward AI as integrated as a recurrent brain)
note: Feedforward best Phi=2.36 << recurrent Phi=14.1492 (6.0x). Supports the majority IIT view that a purely feedforward computer (transformer-like, acyclic) carries far less integrated Phi than a recurrent coupled substrate. Honest caveat: ECA SHIFT/IDENTITY are the closest feedforward analogues the ECA toolkit allows; SHIFT(r170) is not strictly zero-feedback (ring wrap), so the >0 residual is expected — the gap, not absolute zero, is the result.
